highlights.title: Add several computers in one sitting
highlights.line: Pairing to Kosmos+ now allows 10 code tries per computer and 20 answers a day; one stuck at the old limits can finish once both Macs update.

highlights.title: Close the join notice
highlights.line: The notice that a computer wants to join your Kosmos+ account now has a close button, and stays away until a new request comes in.

highlights.title: Quiet projects stop flagging you
highlights.line: Paused projects and agents out of usage no longer mark a project as an Issue, and every row in a project's needs-you list can be dismissed.

highlights.title: A team map for each project
highlights.line: In the tab layout, a project's Members card now has a Team map: who reports to whom, what each member holds, and who handed work to whom.

highlights.title: Agents are told how to finish a task
highlights.line: An agent that reports on a task it holds, with kosmos task message, is now told how to mark that task done.
